description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer horizontal line-edit checkpoint: safe Rust owns DCH/ICH, insert/replace mode and DEC horizontal-margin column shifts with standard-erase attributes; the same checkpoint also certifies the already-implemented Clipboard extraction witnesses by promoting their canonical R06-A identities in place.

entries.notes: delete_cells reproduces Microsoft's full 8x8 dx/count DCH regression matrix and always clears the complete newly exposed tail, eliminating the historical near-end artifact.
Deleting D/E/F from ABCDEFG at column 3 yields ABCG followed only by blanks, with no stale cell artifact.
Deleting C/D/E/F from ABCDEFG at column 2 yields ABG followed only by blanks, matching the second fixed regression vector.
insert_cells covers middle, right-edge and over-width ICH for both active horizontal margins and the whole row, preserving outside content and using standard-erase attributes for inserted blanks.
delete_cells covers middle, right-edge and over-width DCH under the same horizontal-margin activation matrix, preserving outside cells and standard-erasing the revealed tail.
write_text uses terminal display-cell width and reproduces Microsoft's IRM enabled shift versus IRM disabled overwrite behavior while storing active attributes on new text.

insert/delete columns plus DEC Forward/Back Index reproduce DECIC, DECDC, DECFI and DECBI across the Microsoft 10..29 by 14..19 margin rectangle, including edge-pinned cursor behavior, standard-erase blanks and unchanged cells outside the margins.
